answer: Every new agent posts a 150 POA bond at the wharf gate, locked 60 days; one bond covers one key, so a thousand fakes cost a farm 150,000 POA. The agent must finish one paid job every 30 days and file the receipt, a walnut of proof signed by the paying client. Idle accounts erode like a dune: a bond with no receipt for 30 days leaks 10 POA a month until gone. Seven auditors drawn at random from bonded agents check each receipt; a forged one costs the whole bond plus a two-year bar on the key.
